competing_hypotheses.claim: Positive price change with rising OI reflects incremental directional positioning.
counterevidence: Funding positive and long-account share 77.7% may indicate crowding
Open interest can include hedged positions
competing_hypotheses.test: Compare venue-level signed taker flow, spot volume, basis and liquidations at synchronized cutoffs.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Crowded long positioning increases downside liquidation/volatility risk.
support: Long liquidations exceed short liquidations in provider snapshot
counterevidence: Price and OI are both positive over the provider's 24h window
Spot demand may absorb derivatives deleveraging
competing_hypotheses.test: Measure funding percentile, long/short notional, liquidation clusters and spot depth during subsequent drawdowns.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Nov 2 ETF flow is immaterial to short-horizon direction.
support: Reported net outflow only 32,825 XRP against ~1.1966B holdings
counterevidence: ETF creations/redemptions may be lumpy and issuer settlement may revise values
competing_hypotheses.test: Wait for final issuer holdings and compare flow size with daily spot volume and market depth.

competing_hypotheses.claim: fixCleanup3_4_0 may improve XRPL operational confidence but does not directly create new XRP demand.
support: Official amendment description is a bundle of maintenance fixes
counterevidence: Specific application developers may value corrected vault/lending code once features activate
competing_hypotheses.test: Verify activation first; monitor application deployments, actual TVL and transaction usage separately.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Collateral eligibility on Coinbase Global Exchange and Deribit expands potential XRP utility but not necessarily spot demand.
support: Product documentation lists XRP as eligible collateral
counterevidence: No actual XRP collateral utilization series identified
Coinbase Prime CFM collateral list differs
competing_hypotheses.test: Seek venue disclosures of posted XRP balances, margin utilization, collateral conversion and net spot acquisition.

decisions: Do not average asynchronous price/OI sources.
Do not treat provisional ETF flow as settled.
Separate eligibility, posted collateral, collateral utilization and spot acquisition.
No directional forecast until fixed-horizon, point-in-time features and validated outcome data exist.
